key_safety.text: Most serious risk is permanent vision loss (bilateral concentric visual field constriction in 30 percent or more of adults). In the controlled IS study (n=40), events more frequent than placebo included somnolence (SABRIL 45%, placebo 30%), bronchitis (30% vs 15%), ear infection (10% vs 5%), and acute otitis media (10% vs 0%). Abnormal MRI signal changes were seen in infants (21.5% vigabatrin vs 4.1% untreated).

citations.quote: In adults, SABRIL causes permanent bilateral concentric visual field constriction in 30 percent or more of patients that ranges in severity from mild to severe, including tunnel vision to within 10 degrees of visual fixation, and can result in disability.

citations.quote: In accordance with section 505-1 of FDCA, we have determined that a REMS is necessary for Sabril (vigabatrin) to ensure the benefits of the drug outweigh the risks of vision loss and of suicidal thoughts and behaviors.
The REMS consists of a Medication Guide, a communication plan, elements to assure safe use, an implementation system, and a timetable for submission of assessments of the REMS.
Because of the risk of permanent vision loss, SABRIL is available only through a special restricted distribution program called SHARE, by calling 1-888-45-SHARE.
